mode: original release; automatic SCIP disabled; isolated cache

counts.query: SELECT json_object('label',label,'count',count(*)) AS row FROM nodes GROUP BY label

files.query: SELECT json_object('path',file_path) AS row FROM nodes WHERE label='File' ORDER BY file_path

symbols.query: SELECT json_object('name',name,'label',label,'language',language,'path',file_path,'line',line_start,'data',json(data)) AS row FROM nodes WHERE name IN ('getUnitFlows','HandleRequest','QueryUnitFlows','VirtualTraceDatabase','DbTraceDataBase','TextTraceDatabase','send','fetch','createRequest') ORDER BY file_path,line_start,id

calls.query: SELECT json_object('caller',a.name,'caller_path',a.file_path,'caller_line',a.line_start,'callee',b.name,'callee_path',b.file_path,'callee_line',b.line_start,'relation',e.relation,'data',json(e.data)) AS row FROM edges e JOIN nodes a ON a.id=e.src JOIN nodes b ON b.id=e.dst WHERE e.relation='Calls' AND a.name IN ('getUnitFlows','HandleRequest','send','fetch') ORDER BY e.src,e.dst,e.relation

raw_calls.query: SELECT json_object('caller',n.name,'caller_label',n.label,'callee',c.callee_name,'path',c.file_path,'line',c.line,'receiver',c.receiver) AS row FROM calls c LEFT JOIN nodes n ON n.id=c.caller_id WHERE c.callee_name IN ('QueryUnitFlows','requestData','send','get') ORDER BY c.file_path,c.line
